It iterates the arguments in order and calls ops::to_uint16 on each one with `?`, so the ToUint16 conversions run in spec order and abrupt completions propagate. Each code unit is appended to a Vec<u16>, which is then interned as the result, and an empty argument list gives the empty string. Each spec step is a comment directly above its code. Nothing is special-cased, hardcoded or swallowed, and the only file touched is the one in scope.
